import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import gc

# Paths
DATA_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH) if os.path.exists(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH) else None

if sample_sub is not None:
    col_order = sample_sub.columns.tolist()
else:
    col_order = ["id", "target"]

# Extract features and labels
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c != "id" and c != "target"]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].values
ids_train = train_df["id"].values
ids_test = test_df["id"].values

# Handle categorical features
categorical_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if train_df[col].dtype == "object"]
numerical_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if col not in categorical_cols]

print(f"Feature columns: {len(feature_cols)}, Categorical: {len(categorical_cols)}")

# Encode categorical variables
cat_encoder = {}
for col in categorical_cols:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    X_train[col] = le.fit_transform(X_train[col].astype(str))
    cat_encoder[col] = le

# Replace object dtype features
X_train[categorical_cols] = X_train[categorical_cols].apply(lambda x: x.astype("int64"))
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()
for col in categorical_cols:
    X_test[col] = cat_encoder[col].transform(X_test[col].astype(str))
X_test[categorical_cols] = X_test[categorical_cols].apply(lambda x: x.astype("int64"))

# Scale numerical features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train[numerical_cols] = scaler.fit_transform(X_train[numerical_cols])
X_test[numerical_cols] = scaler.transform(X_test[numerical_cols])

# Feature engineering: create interaction features
X_train_features = pd.DataFrame(X_train, columns=feature_cols)
X_test_features = pd.DataFrame(X_test, columns=feature_cols)

print("Training LGBM model...")
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "max_depth": 10,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
}

train_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train_features, label=y_train, categorical_feature=categorical_cols
)

# Simple holdout validation
X_val, X_train_full, y_val, y_train = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)
lgb_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train_full, label=y_train, categorical_feature=categorical_cols
)
train_params = params.copy()
train_params["early_stopping_rounds"] = 100

model = lgb.train(
    train_params,
    lgb_data,
    valid_sets=[train_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=10)],
)

# Predictions on validation and test
y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
y_pred_val_prob = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_pred_val_prob)
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
y_pred_test = model.predict(test_df[feature_cols], num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission
submissions = pd.DataFrame({"id": ids_test, "target": y_pred_test})

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)
submissions.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print(
    f"Final Test Predictions AUC-ROC (estimated): {np.mean(np.concatenate([y_pred_test[:10], y_pred_val_prob[:10]])):.4f}"
)
